title: App Workspace Pre-existing Test & Typecheck Cleanup

sprint.goal: Clear the pre-existing app workspace failures (4 typecheck errors and ~133 test failures across 34+ files) so the app suite can pass green gates and unblocks future frontend tracks.
stories: S1: Catalog and reproduce all app typecheck errors
S2: Catalog and reproduce all app test failures
S3: Fix typecheck errors with minimal source changes
S4: Fix test failures grouped by root cause (MSW, timers, mocks, rendering)
S5: Verify app test and typecheck gates
sprint.demo_notes: Run `cd app && bun run typecheck` and `cd app && bun run test` and observe both pass with zero failures.
